summary.detail: M.Sc. in AI and related fields. Fee-paying by default; merit-based funding may be available through a faculty-sponsored research or teaching assistantship, or an approved government scholarship (UAE nationals); funding is not guaranteed. Funded students receive free tuition, a monthly stipend (AED 15,500 international / 37,500 UAE nationals), annual return airfare, health insurance and a UAE residence visa. Applicants need a STEM degree with CGPA 3.0 or 3.5 depending on programme.
summary.source_text: The funding model and benefits described on this page apply to the Ph.D. and M.Sc. programs.
